positive_cases.name: password_failure
positive_cases.scenario: Password authentication failure for a standard user.
positive_cases.rationale: Daemon and failure message selections both match.

positive_cases.name: invalid_user_failure
positive_cases.scenario: Password authentication failure for an unknown account.
positive_cases.rationale: Daemon and failure message selections both match.

negative_cases.name: successful_key_authentication
negative_cases.rationale: The failure message selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: session_closed
negative_cases.rationale: The failure message selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: sudo_authentication_failure
negative_cases.scenario: Privilege escalation authentication failure reported by another program.
negative_cases.rationale: The daemon selection does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
